recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, high-contrast profile portrait of a figure bathed in intense orange rim lighting against a dark, grainy background, featuring clean geometric typography with a distinct glowing effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm orange highlights contrasting against deep teal-black shadows
Heavy film grain texture unifying the subject and the negative space
Geometric, thin-weight typography balanced against the organic curves of the profile
Soft-focus glow on the subject's face echoing the outer glow of the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Profile of a figure on the left third, facing left, occupying approximately 40% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange glow on the face and shoulder acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright profile, follow the light down the arm, then move right to the glowing title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of dark, textured space on the right side provides room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/teal-black for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and amber for the light source and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the secondary metadata text and logo elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the highlights (orange) against very low value/desaturated shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to amber, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'e' with a perfectly horizontal crossbar
Lowercase 'a' with a circular bowl and no spur

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and case contrast.
graphicDevices: Outer glow effect on primary text
Parental advisory box in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and thin weights.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile portrait of a person with long curly hair, facing left. Use intense orange rim lighting from the left. The background should be dark teal-black with heavy 35mm film grain and light leaks. The right side of the frame should be mostly empty dark space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a lowercase title in a thin geometric sans-serif font in the center-right. Apply a soft orange outer glow to the title. Below it, add a subtitle in all-caps with wide letter spacing in an amber color, aligned to the right edge of the title.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting strictly orange and high-contrast?
Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Is the main title in lowercase geometric sans-serif?
Is the subtitle right-aligned with wide tracking?

postGenerationChecks: Check for haloing around the text glow
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the facial features
Verify the geometric circularity of the 'o' characters
Confirm the right-aligned hierarchy of the text block
recipe.reuseFormula: Profile portrait + Intense Orange Rim Light + Heavy Film Grain + Geometric Sans-Serif Typography with Outer Glow.
